title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Brokers, Accounts, and Placing Your First Order

questions.text: What is the primary function of a stockbroker in Trinidad and Tobago?
options: To provide legal advice on tax matters
To verify identity and route orders to the market
To set share prices for listed companies
To manage the Central Depository's vault
questions.explanation: Brokers verify client identity and send orders to the exchange.

questions.text: True or false: A limit order guarantees immediate execution at the best available price.
questions.explanation: A limit order only executes if the market reaches the specified price or better, not immediately.
